prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Venkat bhai, Divya didi, Venkat R., Anita didi.
The chat covers 24/03/26, 6:30 pm to 24/03/26, 8:30 pm. It must have exactly 28 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
24/03/26, 7:39 pm - Venkat bhai: Divya didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
24/03/26, 6:30 pm - Divya didi: Haan bolo Venkat bhai, kya update hai aaj ka?
24/03/26, 6:33 pm - Venkat bhai: Aaj ka total collection kitna hua hai?
24/03/26, 6:35 pm - Venkat R.: Bhai maine saare QR code ke payments verify kar liye hain.
24/03/26, 6:38 pm - Anita didi: Good evening everyone, late log in kiya maine aaj.
24/03/26, 6:42 pm - Divya didi: Suno Anita, wo uncle waala payment pending hai kya abhi bhi?
24/03/26, 6:45 pm - Anita didi: Haan didi, unko OTP ka issue aa raha tha shayad.
24/03/26, 6:48 pm - Venkat bhai: Kisi ko password ya PIN mat bolna phone pe.
24/03/26, 6:52 pm - Venkat R.: Obviously bhai, customer care ban ke toh nahi baat kar rahe hum.
24/03/26, 6:55 pm - Divya didi: Venkat R., tum wo Excel sheet email kar do sabko.
24/03/26, 7:00 pm - Venkat R.: Haan didi, bas 5 minute mein bhejta hoon.
24/03/26, 7:05 pm - Anita didi: Chai peene chalein sab?
24/03/26, 7:10 pm - Venkat bhai: Pehle aaj ka hisaab khatam karo poora.
24/03/26, 7:15 pm - Divya didi: Main audit report taiyar kar rahi hoon.
24/03/26, 7:20 pm - Venkat R.: Ek payment me mismatch lag raha hai mujhe.
24/03/26, 7:25 pm - Anita didi: Konsa payment? ID batao main check karti hoon.
24/03/26, 7:30 pm - Venkat R.: Wo 50,000 waala transfer. Name mismatch hai.
24/03/26, 7:35 pm - Divya didi: Achha wo waala, haan wo thoda suspicious lag raha tha.
24/03/26, 7:39 pm - Venkat bhai: Divya didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
24/03/26, 7:42 pm - Divya didi: Ok bhai, main system se remove kar deti hoon.
24/03/26, 7:46 pm - Anita didi: Par bhai, internal audit me dikhega nahi kya?
24/03/26, 7:50 pm - Venkat bhai: Main dekh lunga wo, tum tension mat lo.
24/03/26, 7:55 pm - Venkat R.: Sahi hai, warna complaint raise ho sakti hai.
24/03/26, 8:00 pm - Divya didi: Done, entry remove kar di hai log book se.
24/03/26, 8:05 pm - Anita didi: Wahi better hai, kisi ko pata nahi chalega.
24/03/26, 8:10 pm - Venkat R.: Baaki saare transactions clear hain aaj ke.
24/03/26, 8:15 pm - Venkat bhai: Theek hai, ab kal subah meeting karenge 10 baje.
24/03/26, 8:22 pm - Divya didi: Okay bhai, good night sabko.
24/03/26, 8:30 pm - Anita didi: Good night, kal milte hain office me.
